result.brief: 提出 Skill-JEPA：用状态条件 VAE 将短动作序列编码为高斯先验下的潜在技能，使 JEPA 世界模型预测技能效果、规划器在同一高斯空间搜索，显著提升远距离目标成功率。
result.reason: Learns a planner-aligned latent action space (state-conditioned VAE skills) for JEPA world models, improving latent prediction and long-horizon planning; core world-model representation contribution.
